MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING
  JANUARY 14, 2025
  MALIBU WEST BEACH CLUB
  2:00 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Stewart called the meeting to order at 2:09 pm.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Doug Stewart; Mayor Pro Tern Marianne Riggins; and
  Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad and Bruce Silverstein

  ABSENT: Councilmember Steve Uhring.

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Joseph Toney, Assistant City
  Manager; Alexis Brown, Deputy City Manager; and Kelsey Pettijohn, City Clerk

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Dennis Smith led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  City Clerk Pettijohn reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  January l3, 205.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Mayor Pro Tem Riggins moved, and Councilmember Silverstein seconded a
  motion to approve the agenda. The motion carried 4—0, Councilmember Uhring
  absent.

ITEM 1  NEW BUSINESS

  Resolution Ratifving the Director of Emergency Services’ Proclamation of the
  Existence of a Local Emergency
  Recommended Action: 1) Adopt Resolution No. 25—01, confirming existence of a
  local emergency, and ratifying the proclamation of local emergency by the Acting
  Director of Emergency Services; and 2) Approve and authorize the submittal of a
  letter requesting recovery assistance from the State of California in accordance
  with the California Disaster Assistance Act (CDAA).
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of January 14, 2025
  Page 2 of 3

  Acting City Manage Toney discussed flre response and recovery, including plans
  a Town Hall on January 21, 2025. He discussed plans to augment staffing and the
  Governor’s recent Executive Order to help residents rebuild faster.

  Mayor Stewart discussed the City’s Emergency Operations Center (EOC)
  operations and locations. He commended city staff for their work and thanked the
  agencies that provided mutual aid. He thanked the first responders who saved
  everyone they could.

  Acting City Manager Toney presented the staff report.

  Mayor Stewart opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Pamela Conley Ulich, Ann Buxie, Kraig Hill, Luca Iacovoni, and Don
  Schmitz

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Stewart returned the matter to the
  table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item.

m  MOTION  Mayor Pro Tem Riggins moved to 1) Adopt Resolution N0. 25-01, confirming
  existence of a local emergency, and ratifying the proclamation of local emergency
  by the Acting Director of Emergency Services; and 2) Approve and authorize the
  submittal of a letter requesting recovery assistance from the State of California in
  accordance with the Califomia Disaster Assistance Act (CDAA).

  The Council discussed the item.

  Councilmember Silverstein seconded the motion.

  FRIENLY AMENDMENT
  Councilmember Silverstein moved to include a request in the CDAA letter to
  provide the same assistance to the Frankline Fire as is provided for the Palisades
  Fire.

  The amendment was accepted by the maker and the seconder.

  The motion carried 4-0, Councilmember Uhring absent.

  Professional Services Agreement with CJ Biomonitoring, LLC for Biological
  Consulting Services
  Recommended Action: Authorize the Mayor to execute a two-year Professional
  Services Agreement with CJ Biomonitoring, LLC for biological consulting
  SerVlCBS .

  Acting City Manager Toney presented the staff report.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of January 14, 2025
  Page 3 of 3

  Mayor Stewart opened the floor to public comment. As there were no speakers
  present, Mayor Stewart returned the matter to the table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item.

MOTION  Mayor Pro Tern Riggins moved, and Councilmember Conrad seconded a motion
  to authorize the Mayor to execute a two-year Professional Services Agreement
  with CJ Biomonitoring, LLC for biological consulting services. The motion
  carried 4-0, Councilmember Uhring absent.

  Mayor Stewart reopened the floor for public comment for a late speaker.

  Speaker: Rafi Anteby

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Stewart closed the floor to public
  comment.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Stewart adj ourned the meeting at 2:35 pm.
